Qostara Estimates provides professional construction estimating, quantity takeoff, MEP estimating, and shop drawing services for contractors, subcontractors, builders, developers, and construction professionals.

Our approach

Your Plans. Our Expertise. A Clearer Path to Your Bid.

Estimating a construction project requires more than measuring quantities. It requires understanding drawings, specifications, materials, labor requirements, subcontractor scopes, and current project costs.

At Qostara Estimates, our estimating team reviews your project documents, performs detailed quantity takeoffs, develops trade-specific estimates, and organizes the information into a professional bid-ready format.

Whether you need a single-trade takeoff or a complete multi-trade estimate, we help turn complex construction documents into usable cost information.

How it works

From Drawings to a Bid-Ready Estimate

  1. 01

    Submit Your Project

    Send us your plans, specifications, scope documents, addendums, and other project information.

  2. 02

    Project Review

    Our estimating team reviews the available documentation and identifies the trades, scopes, quantities, and information required for the estimate.

  3. 03

    Quantity Takeoff

    We measure, count, and organize project quantities according to the drawings and specifications.

  4. 04

    Cost Estimating

    Quantities are developed into detailed costs for materials, labor, equipment, subcontractors, and other applicable expenses.

  5. 05

    Quality Review

    The estimate is reviewed for quantity consistency, scope coverage, pricing, assumptions, and exclusions.

  6. 06

    Delivery

    Receive a structured estimate that can be used for bidding, budgeting, project planning, and internal review.
